question: Which upstream sites retain target incidence after generic same-answer transport is measured with endpoint-aligned controls?
predecessor_invalid: v1 exposed no causal result: all shipped C base/donor pairs have unequal semantic endpoints, making full-prefix module interchange undefined.
population: From each frozen builder's transform-C base rows, retain endpoint groups 12 and 14. Within each task and endpoint, deterministically rotate the base documents by one to create a different donor with the identical answer, foil, token length, and semantic endpoint. This yields 28 temporal and 14 is/was aligned rows. Odd/even positions within each endpoint group are assigned to discovery/validation before outcomes.
sites: The same complete 179-site population as the target atlas: all 162 heads in layers 0--17 and MLP0--16.
intervention: For every site and split, patch its full native response from the matched C donor into C base and measure final answer-margin and both frozen physical-reader mode movements. Base, donor, and self patches are included.
selection: Using discovery controls only, rank by frozen target causal magnitude divided by 0.05 plus worst task-normalized control movement, then target magnitude. Freeze top20 before validation.

predictions.pred_a_authority_alignment_self_patch_fi: All 42 rows are distinct-donor, answer/foil/length/endpoint aligned; 179 sites close; self patch <=1e-4; finite; <=366 forwards and 7644 evaluations.
predictions.pred_b_mlp1_is_generic_transport: MLP1 is discovery-control top-decile in both tasks and validation effect >=0.20 target scale in one task.
predictions.pred_d_selective_pool_contains_known_wri: Selective top20 contains at least two of L9H1/L9H4/MLP7/MLP9 and a layer-8--11 attention site.
predictions.pred_e_selective_pool_improves_validatio: Versus original tensor top20, selective top20 halves median validation control while retaining >=50% median target magnitude.

decision: Screen only. A later union may use the discovery-frozen pool; validation cannot alter selection.
